record.body:
## Interfaces

pyproject.toml declares runtime deps (textual, rich, fastapi, uvicorn), dev dependency-group, explicit packages including dashboard, dashboard.web, installer, installer.adapters, and orchestra.sessions, plus installer package-data for providers.json. orchestra/score/effort_rollup.py is re-exported from orchestra.score; session modules live under orchestra/sessions/ with report/aggregate entrypoints unchanged for orchestra.cli. orchestra.cli imports canon, suite, and check at module level (R9–R11); sessions subcommand no longer swallows ModuleNotFoundError. orchestra/_scripts symlink removed. scripts/test.sh and orchestra.conductor.suite FAST/TMUX fallbacks use uv run pytest without --no-project/--with; README and AGENTS.md aligned. tests/test_wheel_contents.py covers R1–R15 and R27; tests/test_cli_packaging.py and tests/integration/test_declared_install.py copy dashboard and installer into install fixtures; session and effort_rollup tests import package paths.

## Assumptions

Acceptance for R16–R18 and R23–R26 is satisfied by file content in the tree (not separate pytest cases). R19–R22 and R29 were checked with uv run and scripts/test.sh in this worktree (full suite exit 0 on a clean run). uv.lock is not part of the phase diff; dev tools rely on [dependency-groups] dev in pyproject.toml and default uv run behavior.

## Invariants

dashboard and installer remain top-level packages (not orchestra.*); installer.paths.source_root still resolves to the parent of the installer package; runtime vs dev dependency lists are separate; tests/test_boundaries.py passes; editable/wheel install tests in test_wheel_contents.py and test_cli_packaging.py pass in this worktree.

## Conflicts

pyproject.toml still lists orchestra package-data `_scripts/*.py` and a comment referring to a checkout symlink after _scripts was deleted—leftover packaging metadata, not exercised as a failure by phase tests.
